title: Hierarchical Semantic Tree Anchoring for CLIP-Based Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.15633v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to learn new classes continually while preserving past knowledge. Recently, vision-language models like CLIP offer transferable features via multimodal pre-training, making them well-suited for CIL. However, real-world visual and linguistic concepts are inherently hierarchical: a textual concept like "dog" subsumes fine-grained categories such as "Labrador" and "Golden Retriever," and each category is associated with corresponding images. Nevertheless, existing CLIP-based CIL methods fail to explicitly capture this inherent hierarchy, leading to feature drift of fine-grained classes during incremental updates and ultimately to catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose HASTEN (Hierarchical Semantic Tree Anchoring), a hierarchy-aware framework that uses semantic structure to stabilize CLIP-based CIL. translated_title: 面向基于CLIP的类增量学习的层次语义树锚定方法
translated_abstract: 类增量学习（CIL）使模型能够在持续学习新类别的同时保留已有知识。近来，以CLIP为代表的视觉-语言模型通过多模态预训练提供了可迁移的特征，使其非常适合类增量学习任务。然而，现实世界中的视觉与语言概念天然具有层次性：例如“狗”这一文本概念涵盖了“拉布拉多”和“金毛寻回犬”等细粒度类别，且每个类别都与相应的图像相关联。尽管如此，现有的基于CLIP的类增量学习方法未能显式地捕捉这种固有的层次结构，导致细粒度类别在增量更新过程中发生特征漂移，最终引发灾难性遗忘。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HASTEN（层次语义树锚定），一个利用语义结构来稳定基于CLIP的类增量学习的层次感知框架。HASTEN不再将类别视为孤立的标签，而是利用……
tldr: 提出HASTEN框架，通过层次语义树锚定细粒度类别的语义结构，从而缓解基于CLIP的类增量学习中的特征漂移与灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes HASTEN, a hierarchy-aware framework that anchors fine-grained classes using hierarchical semantic trees to mitigate feature drift and catastrophic forgetting in CLIP-based class-incremental learning.
